operations.description: Use this endpoint to delete a message that's been scheduled for sending, but hasn't yet sent.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete message by id [PATH] messages [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content id language message telstra type version [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Use this endpoint to fetch the Free Trial Number(s) currently assigned to your account. These are the mobile numbers that you can message during the Free Trial.

If you're using a paid plan, there's no limit to the number of recipients that you can message, so you don't need to register Free Trial Numbers.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] trial numbers [PATH] free trial numbers [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content language telstra type version [SCHEMA] free numbers trial

operations.description: Use this endpoint to check the operational status of the messaging service. A 200 OK response means the service is up. If you receive a 504 response, the service is temporarily down. Check the [API Live Status page] (https://dev.telstra.com/api/status) to see if there's an active incident.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] health check [PATH] health check [PARAMS] authorization telstra version [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Fetch messages that have been sent from/to your account in the last 30 days.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] messages [PATH] messages [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content direction filter language limit offset status telstra type version [SCHEMA] message multimedia

operations.description: Use the **messageId** to fetch a message that's been sent from/to your account within the last 30 days.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] message by id [PATH] messages [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content id language message telstra type version [SCHEMA] message multimedia

operations.description: Fetch details of all reports recently generated for your account. Use it to check the status of a report, plus fetch the report ID, status, report type and expiry date.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] reports [PATH] reports [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content language telstra type version [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Fetch a download link for a report generated with POST /reports/{reportId} using the **reportId** returned in the response. Once ready, your report will be available for download for one week.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] report [PATH] reports [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content id language report telstra type version [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Use this endpoint to fetch all Virtual Numbers currently assigned to your account.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] numbers [PATH] virtual numbers [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content filter language limit offset telstra type version [SCHEMA] number paging virtual

operations.description: Fetch the tags, replyCallbackUrl and lastUse date for a Virtual Number.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] virtual number [PATH] virtual numbers [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content language number telstra type version virtual [SCHEMA] number virtual

operations.description:
Use this endpoint to fetch any mobile number(s) that have opted out of receiving messages from a Virtual Number assigned to your account.

Recipients can opt out at any time by sending a message with industry standard keywords such as STOP, STOPALL, UNSUBSCRIBE, QUIT, END and CANCEL.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] recipient optouts [PATH] virtual numbers optouts [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content language limit number offset telstra type version virtual [SCHEMA] optout paging recipient

operations.description: Use the **messageId** to update the tag(s) assigned to a message. You can use this endpoint any time, even after your message has been delivered.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] update message tags [PATH] messages [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content id language message telstra type version [SCHEMA] message tags

operations.description:
Your Free Trial Numbers are the 10 recipient mobile numbers that you can message during the Free Trial. The first five numbers you send an SMS/MMS to will automatically be added to your Free Trial Numbers list. After that, you can use this endpoint to register another five. Alternatively, you can use this endpoint to register all 10 numbers.  

Use this endpoint to register a Free Trial Number to your account. To test out all the features that the trial has to offer, we recommend registering your own mobile number to your Free Trial Numbers list. 

Note that you can only message mobile numbers that have been added to your Free Trial list and once registered, a Free Trial Number cannot be removed or replaced.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create trial numbers [PATH] free trial numbers [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content language telstra type version [SCHEMA] free numbers trial

operations.description:
Send an SMS/MMS to a mobile number, or to multiple mobile numbers.

Free Trial users can message to up to 10 unique recipient numbers for free. The first five recipients will be automatically added to your Free Trial Numbers list. Need more? Just use the POST /free-trial-numbers call to add another five.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] send messages [PATH] messages [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content language telstra type version [SCHEMA] message multimedia sent

operations.description:
Request a CSV report of messages (both incoming and outgoing) that have been sent to/from your account within the last three months. You can request details for a specific timeframe, and filter your messages by tags, recipient number or Virtual Number.

A 201 Created means your report has been queued for generation. Make a note of the reportId returned in the response. You'll need this to check the status of your report and fetch your download link with GET reports/{reportId}. If you supplied a reportCallbackUrl in the request we'll also notify it when your report is ready for download.

Once your report is generated, it will be available for download for one week. The expiry date is returned in the response.
operations.summary: submit a request for a messages report
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] messages report [PATH] reports messages [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content language telstra type version [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
When a recipient receives your message, you can choose whether they'll see a privateNumber, Virtual Number or senderName (paid plans only) in the **from** field. If you want to use a Virtual Number, use this endpoint to assign one. Free Trial users can assign one Virtual Number, and those on a paid plan can assign up to 100. 

Virtual Numbers that have not sent a message in 30 days (Free Trial) or sent/received a message in 18 months (paid plans) will be automatically unassigned from your account. You can check the **lastUse** date of your Virtual Number at any time using GET /virtual-numbers/{virtual-number}.

Note that Virtual Numbers used in v2 of the Messaging API cannot be used to send messages in v3. Please assign a new Virtual Number instead.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] assign number [PATH] virtual numbers [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content language telstra type version [SCHEMA] number virtual

operations.description: Need to update a message that's scheduled for sending? You can change any of the below parameters, as long as the message hasn't been sent yet. This request body will override the original POST/ messages call.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] update message by id [PATH] messages [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content id language message telstra type version [SCHEMA] message multimedia put update

operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] update number [PATH] virtual numbers [PARAMS] accept authorization charset content language number telstra type version virtual [SCHEMA] number put virtual
